driver.lane_label: diagnostic: explicit unverified Trust lane (-Ztrust-verify=off for direct compiles, targo --unverified for builds); no Trust-verified compilation claim

cpu_policy.source: derived from each lane's compile command
cpu_policy.statement: LANE COMMANDS DIFFER beyond -Zcodegen-backend (see the flag lists). No -C target-cpu / -C target-feature is passed: the LLVM lane compiles for the target's default CPU (llvm_default_target_cpu); the trust-cg lane selects instructions by its own per-target ISA profile (AArch64: AArch64IsaProfile::for_aot_target in crates/trust-cg-codegen/src/target.rs).

rss_sampling.method: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss read by a single-child Python wrapper (benchmarks/beat-llvm/peak_rss.py) after the child is reaped, normalised to bytes; the largest single process in the measured tree, not a sum
rss_sampling.peak_rss_bytes: the compiled program: one dedicated run per lane, outside the timed loop
rss_sampling.compile_peak_rss_bytes: the compiler: the largest single process of the rustc invocation (rustc or its cc/ld link step), one dedicated compile per lane, outside the timed loop
rss_sampling.gate: contract/gates.json version 2: R1 (fails if any program's bridge reading exceeds max(its LLVM -O3 reading, the floor) by more than 5%; passes only when every program's comparison is resolved; otherwise unmeasured) and R2 (compiler peak-RSS geomean <= 1.00x LLVM -O2, no floor-bound compiler reading); the program-RSS geomean is reported, not gated
rss_sampling.floor_rule: every reading is at least sampler_floor_bytes and one above it is the process's peak; a comparison is resolved only when both readings are above 2x sampler_floor_bytes

provenance.aggregation: median-of-N per program (compile N=3, run N=5 after 1 warmup); raw samples retained per program as times_s

proof_checker.order: aterm-packaged (PATH <prefix>/bin), then the driver's sysroot bin/clean
